caption: The drawing depicts a single bottle with a relatively tall, narrow neck and a wider, rectangular base. The bottle features a marbled pattern with shades of pink, red, and white, resembling streaks or veins that run vertically and diagonally over its surface. The neck of the bottle is predominantly white with faint pink accents, and the wide mouth is rimmed with a darker pink on its inner edge. The bottle is set against a plain beige background, and a grayish-brown shadow extends to the left and slightly forward from its base, indicating a light source from the right. There are no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Barber's Bottle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
